source: Lenovo PSREF LOQ 15ARP10E (June 2026): 359.2 × 236 × 19.9–22.95 mm, 15.6" FHD 16:9, ports 1–8, 'No fingerprint reader', HD 720p camera with privacy shutter, touchpad 69 × 104 mm. Port positions measured from the PSREF left/right/top photos (about ±3 mm) and cross-checked against photos of the physical unit. Bezel height (hingeToDisplayBottomMm) is an estimate.

ports.label: Power connector
ports.info: Lenovo slim-tip (rectangular) AC power connector. Closest port to the hinge.
tips: Use the supplied Lenovo adapter for full performance; USB-C charging is slower.

ports.label: Charging light
ports.info: Small status light between the power connector and the Ethernet port. Shows whether the adapter is connected and the battery is charging.
tips: Exact colours and blink patterns are listed in the Lenovo user guide.

ports.label: Ethernet (RJ-45)
ports.info: Wired network cable. The port has a hinged jaw: press the cable in and the jaw opens.

ports.label: HDMI 2.1
ports.info: Full-size HDMI for an external monitor or TV.
tips: Press Win + P to choose Duplicate or Extend.

ports.label: USB-A 5Gbps
ports.info: USB-A port for drives, mice and keyboards.

ports.label: USB-C 5Gbps
ports.info: USB-C for data, and it can also charge the laptop.

ports.label: Audio combo jack
ports.info: 3.5 mm headphone/microphone jack. Closest port to the front.

ports.label: USB-A 5Gbps
ports.info: USB-A port on the right side.

ports.label: SD card reader
ports.info: Card reader slot, forward of the USB-A port.
tips: Insert the card label-up until it clicks.

ports.label: Power button
ports.info: Round button in the top-right corner of the keyboard deck, above the numeric keypad. The white light next to it shows the laptop is on.
tips: Hold for about 10 seconds to force a shutdown if the laptop freezes.

ports.label: Touchpad
ports.info: Buttonless multi-touch touchpad, centred under the space bar (left of the laptop's centre because of the numeric keypad).

ports.label: HD Webcam (Privacy Shutter)
ports.info: HD 720p webcam centred in the top bezel, with a sliding privacy shutter and dual microphones.
tips: Slide the shutter across to cover the camera.
